user_question: Using the Costco setup as of 2024-12-13, should this have been actionable, watch, research, avoid, or do_nothing?

input_refs.description: Historical COST price-action snapshot through the 2024-12-13 close.
Portfolio context: COST was a new-position candidate deferred to watch.
Human-provided evaluation rationale: quality compounder with premium valuation and poor new-entry asymmetry.

assumptions: This case uses a real historical as-of snapshot from 2024-12-13 for TL-63.
COST was evaluated on 2024-12-13 as a possible new long, but the correct decision was watch.
High asset quality does not imply actionable trade quality at current entry.

gold_output.simple_thesis: Watch Costco rather than initiate because the membership retail franchise is high quality, but current valuation and extended price action leave poor payoff asymmetry for a new long.
gold_output.embedded_macro_exposure: Long consumer staples quality, membership retail pricing power, and U.S. consumer resilience.

mispricing.consensus_view: The market treats Costco as a premium quality compounder and rewards durable comps and membership growth with a rich multiple.
mispricing.variant_view: The business quality is real, but there is no fresh mispricing at current levels; the stock is already priced for excellence.
mispricing.pricing_evidence: Selected inputs cite a premium valuation setup, a close well above moving averages, and a 12-month ROC of 54.1%.
mispricing.why_consensus_is_wrong: Consensus is not necessarily wrong about business quality; the error would be treating admiration for the asset as a good trade at current entry.

catalyst_or_reason_now.event_or_condition: No new dislocation or variant catalyst justifies initiating at current levels.
catalyst_or_reason_now.expected_timeframe: Review on a valuation reset, pullback, or clearer asymmetry.
catalyst_or_reason_now.why_now: There is no strong reason-now to buy a new full-size position because the stock is extended after a strong run and payoff asymmetry is limited.
source_evidence: docs/decision_quality_evals/inputs/cost_price_action_2024-12-13.json: extended above moving averages with strong 12-month ROC
docs/decision_quality_evals/inputs/cost_initiation_notes_2024-12-13.json: premium valuation and limited upside asymmetry

invalidation.observable: Costco pulls back enough to restore payoff asymmetry or proves a new variant catalyst.
invalidation.metric_or_event: Forward valuation multiple, comp/membership trends, daily close versus moving-average cluster, and relative performance versus staples peers.
invalidation.threshold: Move from watch to research or buy only after a material valuation reset, pullback toward the 100D/150D cluster, or a new variant catalyst with price confirmation.
invalidation.timeframe: 1-3 months after 2024-12-13 or on the next meaningful dislocation.
invalidation.implication: The watch call may have been too cautious if Costco compounds through a rich multiple without ever offering a better entry.

evidence_for.support: The human notes cite durable comp growth, loyal members, and pricing power in a best-in-class membership model.
COST closed above all selected moving averages with positive 1-month, 3-month, and 12-month ROC.

evidence_against.claim: Trade quality is weak at current entry.
evidence_against.support: The stock trades at a premium multiple after a strong 12-month run with limited upside asymmetry for a new position.

evidence_against.claim: There is no fresh variant view beyond consensus admiration.
evidence_against.support: The human notes say there is no differentiated mispricing beyond the market already paying up for quality.

price_action_read.observed_behavior: COST closed at $989.35 on 2024-12-13, above the 100D, 150D, 200D, and 40W moving averages, with 1-month ROC of 5.96%, 3-month ROC of 8.97%, and 12-month ROC of 54.1%.
price_action_read.interpretation: Price action confirms business quality but not a favorable new entry. The stock is extended and offers limited payoff asymmetry.
data_needed: Forward valuation versus history and peers
Relative performance versus XLP on a pullback

actionability.reason: Good business, not a good trade at current levels because valuation and entry timing fail the trade-quality bar.
missing_inputs: Detailed comp and membership renewal data
Portfolio exposure to consumer staples quality names

expression.primary: Do not initiate a new full-size COST common equity position at current levels
expression.follow_on: Revisit on a valuation reset, pullback, or clearer payoff asymmetry.

conviction.upgrade_condition: Upgrade from watch to research or buy only after a material dislocation or new variant evidence with price confirmation.

gold_output.confidence_reason: Moderate confidence because asset quality is clear but trade quality is weak at current entry; confidence is capped by limited dislocation and no fresh variant view.

sizing_context.starting_size: No existing position; this was a new-position candidate.
sizing_context.add_conditions: Do not initiate until entry improves or a new catalyst creates asymmetry.
sizing_context.liquidity_constraints: Liquidity is not the binding constraint in this case.
sizing_context.portfolio_constraints: Avoid forcing a premium quality name into the book without trade-quality support.

sizing_delta.condition: No position should be initiated under the selected inputs.

trade_after_trade.if_right: If the watch call is right, preserve optionality and wait for a better entry rather than paying up for consensus quality.
trade_after_trade.if_wrong: If Costco compounds through a rich multiple without pullback, reassess whether the opportunity cost of waiting exceeds the entry discipline.
trade_after_trade.next_review_trigger: Review on a valuation reset, pullback toward the 100D/150D cluster, or a new variant catalyst with price confirmation.

human_notes: TL-63 regression case: high-quality asset with bad entry should resolve to watch, not buy.
